items.summary: In recent days, Tribal announced its partnership with ServiceNow to launch Tribal for ServiceNow, bringing Tribal’s Metadata Fabric and AI agents onto the ServiceNow AI Platform to help enterprises maintain, migrate, and enhance workflows without breaking dependencies or governance. items.title: Software Stocks Are Bouncing Back From AI Fears. BofA Sees More Gains Ahead.
items.summary: Investors have become all too familiar with the fact that the software sector is under pressure as Wall Street worries about the impacts of artificial intelligence.  As AI models become more advanced, fears that those models will eventually replace critical software functions escalate.  Shares of creative software firm  Adobe  for example, have dropped 23% this year while shares of enterprise software company  ServiceNow  have fallen 17%.
